assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: The shore as a horizontal line with O the point nearest the yacht Y, 15 above O; the blue boat path from Y to the landing point L, x to the right of O, makes the angle theta with the dotted line YO, and the red ambulance path runs along the shore from L to the hospital H, a distance 60 - x.

difficulty_rationale: The same no-calculus idea as a refraction problem: one must find the inequality 9 sqrt(225+x^2) >= 15 sqrt(77) + 2x (a perfect square) and then convert the landing point into an angle.
